summary: Secrets are kept in your installation's own Key Vault, and break-glass keeps working after an identity move.

fixes.title: Secrets move into your own Key Vault
fixes.text: Once support has given access, the updater places every secret in the installation's Key Vault, with a check and automatic restore.

fixes.title: Rotated secrets are stored in Key Vault
fixes.text: A rotated secret is now written to the Key Vault too.

fixes.title: Break-glass works after an identity move
fixes.text: Before, break-glass activation could be refused after the web identity moved, until the passphrase was set again. Key Vault access now moves with the identity.
